name: Glimmen
slug: Glimmen is Walker's mind-linked dragon companion who supports his decisions, joins him in ceremonies, and flies with him through The Reach.
description: Glimmen is Walker’s mind-linked dragon and a trusted companion who supports his decisions and accompanies him in important moments. She respectfully participates in significant ceremonies and is comfortable with Walker choosing either La-rel or The Reach as their destination. Glimmen has prior memories of traveling through La-rel, including encounters with strange doors, fox people, and shapeshifting experiences. Her ability to fly makes her particularly well suited to traveling alongside Walker through the vast Reach.

log.summary: Glimmen supported Walker’s decision to join Gerk’s new group and remained beside him during the ceremony, respectfully acknowledging the proceedings. She was comfortable with Walker choosing either La-rel or The Reach as his destination. Glimmen recalled her past experiences traveling through La-rel, including its strange doors, fox people, and encounters involving shapeshifting. She also recognized that her ability to fly would make her particularly well suited to traveling the vast expanse of The Reach alongside Walker.
notes: Supports Walker's decision to join Gerk's new group.
Is present beside Walker during the ceremony and respectfully acknowledges the proceedings.
Is comfortable with Walker choosing either La-rel or The Reach.
Has memories of traveling through La-rel and its strange doors, fox people, and shapeshifting experiences.
Is well suited to traveling the vast Reach with Walker because of her ability to fly.

log.summary: Glimmen accompanies Walker, Elrus, and Araden while they investigate the dragon-rider training grounds, carrying Plymouth Gawater through a portal.
notes: Carries Plymouth Gawater through a portal while accompanying Walker, Elrus, and Araden to investigate the dragon-rider training grounds.

log.summary: Glimmen accompanies Walker through Sunder, waiting outside while he shops before joining him at Haven Hold. When Hanzuni invites her to swim, she eagerly dives into the dragon's hoard. Hanzuni remembers her as a hatchling and observes that she is now fully grown and bonded to a rider; the two dragons are roughly similar in size, with Hanzuni only slightly larger.

Is present beside Walker at Haven Hold.

log.summary: Glimmen enters a crevice with Walker by crawling and squeezing, unable to fly in or out. Backtracking would mean squeezing under her; a younger dragon could tuck, hop out, and fly. Over the mind link she says she thought the place was unused and that the death smells fresh. She grumbles at the smell and readies her fiery breath as Walker advances. While crawling she must use Stealth at disadvantage. She has no Stealth bonus, so the check is Dexterity. She rolls a 19 counted as 18 and works along above Walker in a spiral without making much noise.

log.summary: Glimmen is not at the lighthouse; Sylan says the dragon is on a mission. She cannot follow the same path out of the cave and has to backtrack. She meets Walker and Elrus on the plains before the climb to the ruins.

log.summary: Before they go back down, Walker asks Glimmen whether Vecna is still in the cave. Walker is expected to arrive at the stronghold on Glimmen, and Mahali is asked to have food ready for the dragon.
notes: Walker asked Glimmen whether Vecna was still in the cave before they went back down. Walker is expected to arrive at the stronghold on Glimmen, and Mahali is asked to have food ready for the dragon.

log.summary: A dragon linked to Walker this way can use the energy stored in his gems, though to a lesser extent than a dragonrider. Glimmen carries Walker and Plymouth to the stronghold, where the village is used to her; Plymouth dismounts and leaves for New Navel. She then carries Walker, with Araden alongside, toward the forest beacon and overtakes Dana's broom. Their wingbeats are audible as the two dragons arrive while Sylan is proving himself to blind Gerk. They match pace with the party over the dark vortex and land beside the forest.
notes: A dragon linked this way can use the energy stored in Walker's gems, to a lesser extent than a dragonrider.

log.summary: Glimmen asks in Draconic whether Walker has changed since wearing the helm. She starts to answer Dana, then clamps her mouth around Walker's head by the helm and lifts him; the bite hurts her. Through the mind link she tells him to give up the helmet, asks whether phylacteries are flame resistant, and offers to torch it. She says he seems influenced and that she cannot diagnose mind control, then tells Dana he has not acted any stranger than normal, that she still wants to light him on fire to see if it burns, and that he will be fine. She knows Walker's internal fire can spread and protect her through the bond. She lands in the street by Carlkin's lighthouse beside Araden. Carlkin distinguishes the larger copper, Araden, from Glimmen. Walker says that if Grixto is influencing either of them, it would be Glimmen, and he counts her voice among the familiar voices that would not count as Carlkin's warning sign.
